description: This file defines the PHP client class for interacting with the AWS CodeBuild service. It specifies available methods for operations such as creating, deleting, listing, and updating build projects and reports, along with their asynchronous counterparts. The class extends a general AWS client class and is contained within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically in the 'CodeBuild' namespace.

classes.name: CodeBuildClient
classes.description: A client for interacting with AWS CodeBuild service, providing methods for managing build projects, reports, and other related resources.
